blocks.title: A plethora of negative dependence properties and conjectures
blocks.content:
In this section we explain in terms of generating polynomials the probabilistic
notions and negative dependence properties studied in e.g. [55, 65, 72], and we
clarify the connections between these as well as new classes of probability measures
that we introduce below. We then formulate the problems and conjectures made
in [55, 65, 72] that we solve in the next sections.

tive dependence properties listed in §2.1 might not be mutually satisﬁable, and he
suggested a problem that may be formulated as follows.

We note that to disprove just the strongest version of Pemantle’s con- jecture on ULC rank sequences (Conjecture 2.3) we can simply invoke Example 2.2 in §2.1, which combined with Theorem 3.7 shows that Conjecture 2.3 actually fails even for symmetric measures.
